featured_reviews.name: Vasudha Samant
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this as the co-owner of the building which is directly opposite to Kangaroo Kids, Parel east branch. I am extremely concerned with the kind of values your company holds. Not sure if your security personnel are supposed to take care of the people or property they are assigned to or act like 'goondas' and damage other people's property which has nothing to do with the task they have been assigned. One of your security guards named 'Ram', who works for Kangaroo Kids, Parel east branch has been harassing us on behalf of the school. The concerned school is directly opposite to us across a lane. He is involved in illegal cutting down of branches (road facing) of a tree that is within our premises (private property), he was a part of the school team that was involved in the cutting of the branches on Monday morning, 8th July 2024. Even after being asked to stop by my family, he and the school team did not stop, which promotes threatening behavior and that too towards senior citizens. Not sure if he thinks he is a part of BMC (the only body that has right to touch branches facing road (public property) and there too they inform the private property owners if the trees are within the premises of the private property) or if he and the school thinks they own public properties like roads/lanes, or does he look down on the local residents and the Maharashtrian community.
He seems to have absolutely no regards for law or local residents and their properties. Firstly, the school including this guard rarely monitors lane traffic caused due their own cars and blame the residents, secondly, they blatantly promote 2 wheeler parking in our gates that is besides the school ladies standing in our entrance and blocking the gate. Will he and the the school dare this illegal action in an area like Peddar road or Bandra? Or is he flying high on the basis of the brand name and is being backed by money, power, and political influence. Or is he eyeing my property which is across the lane and not even touching this school? The branch head has been threatening everyone saying ''you don't know who I am and what I can do''. The school has also tried using influence on bmc and local police to harass people. The school makes the residents wait in queue when their cars come and they fight with the locals and threaten them if anyone questions. Your security guard has been a part of all these activities.
I am also worried as to what if basis money and power these people (the school authorities, their security, their families) harm my family or damages my property? What are we supposed to do as a common man? I have not added the video here.

featured_reviews.review_text: I had an interview at Godrej on March 31st. Since then, I have visited the office multiple times, yet no official has offered any assistance regarding the next round of interviews. I have been sitting at home for nearly 28 days now. During this period, I received several promising job offers however, the Area Officer at Stealth Management advised me not to go anywhere I will fix you there assuring me that I would definitely get the position at Godrej. Yet, when I visited the office today, the Area Officer did not even answer my calls. Due to this negligence on their part, an entire month of mine has been wasted. Today, I received a response from the office that, currently, they do not have a job opening that matches my profile. My only point is this: if you did not have a suitable job available, why keep a candidate on hold for a whole month? This review is not intended to disparage the company; Stealth is a highly respected organization, and I hold all its officials in high regard. However, if a capable candidate leaves your company feeling disillusioned after waiting for a month, it represents a collective failure. I hope the company will take note of this matter.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear Stealth Management team and Owners,

This is a very specific review which I wish to give. On 10th Sept 2024, in Lodha Florenza Goregaon East, I had a very pleasant experience from the Guards of Stealth. While walking in front of the gate of the above apartment at 10.30 PM, while opening the purse, several Rs. 500 notes got slipped out of pocket and without noticing I left the place for a movie. While returning at 2.30 AM, the guards stopped me and asked me whether I had lost something. Since I had not seen anything falling from pocket, I said No. I went to BMC parking place. The guards followed me and again asked me whether I had lost something. Then I opened my purse and realised that several Rs. 500 notes were missing. They took me to the Supervisor and on further enquiry, it turned out at Rs. 17500 had fallen the road, and the guards diligently had kept it safely and looked at CCTV footage and identified me and handed over the money back (of course after their enquiry process). I must say that this is the kind of guard that Stealth company has kept. Hats off to you the management team for the grooming done to the guards. I can never imagine somebody returning Rs. 17500 which fell on the road and returning it after a gap of 3 hours at mid night. I wish to specifically congratulate the guards on duty and supervisor. Dharmendra Kumar Yadav ID 2422514. Rupesh Tiwari. ID 2422516, Nitish KUmar Ravidas ID 2425366, Ishrar Shamim Khan ID 2422969 and Sahil whose Id is not captured by me.

The management may please take note of this and appreciate them.

Please note that I was just a passerby and not staying in the building at all. A complete stranger to them

I really appreciate the gesture shown by above guards and returning the money.  You may also inform the housing committee members for the is good gesture by their staff.

Thank you so much Stealth. Kudos to the team.
Suresh Pai
